notes.title: HUGE Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]CINEMA :[/b][/u]

[h1]The addition of a Cinema to watch all the naughty content.[/h1]

In the main menu, click on "Cinema".

Gallery mode will now be for images only.
For videos, go directly to the cinema screen.

You no longer have to return to the main menu between each video or image.

[i]Controls Inside the Cinema :[/i]
V = Video Player
G = Gallery

[u][b]Balancing :[/b][/u]

[h1]Some changes :[/h1]

1/ Reaching level 100 will be much faster!

2/ Reduction of some enemy projectiles : 
the squirel, the Rabbit, the Frog, the SCP Pistol girl, the SCP Rocket Girl

3/ The life of all enemies has been reduced

4/ Character sprint speed increased

5/ Weapon damage increased

6/ The number of enemies per level has been reduced in the first map, for a more enjoyable game experience.
